Rebalance & regenerate your mind, body, and spirit

The world-leading Oasis Therapy Center offers the full spectrum of cutting-edge treatments and therapies for the mind, body, and spirit, expertly designed to optimally boost, revitalize and nourish the whole body. Our goal is to cleanse and rebalance from the inside out by eliminating toxins, strengthening immunity, improving mental health with advanced mind-body therapies, and aiding sleep through our various lifestyle-enhancing treatments. Let our expert wellness therapists guide you on your journey of deep relaxation and healing through transformative bodywork and psychotherapy so you can reconnect to your highest wellbeing.
Call now to book your rejuvenation treatment >

Learn more about our treatments & therapies

Mental health

Our mental health therapists have been integral to Hippocrates Wellness for over 30 years, guiding thousands of guests through their limiting mindsets and emotional issues healthily and effectively. You can book a Psych Wellness or Mind-Body Therapy session or explore EMDR, regressions, or Stress Therapy. To get to the root of any issue, we must remember, it’s not just what you eat or what treatments you receive, but it’s about getting to what’s eating you.

Chronic pain

Do you suffer from pain you cannot shake? At Oasis, our team of highly skilled and trained experts offers a wide array of services that can help pinpoint and treat your ailments. Our top recommendations are Physiotherapy, Stretch Therapy, and Acupuncture, but your healing does not have to stop there. We offer Chiropractic Services, Manual Lymph Drainage, Colon Hydrotherapy Services, and so much more.

Relaxation

At our Oasis Therapy Center, we aim to relax and rebalance the whole body. We offer many rejuvenating and revolutionary modalities, from traditional Swedish or Deep Tissue massage to Thai Yoga, Acupuncture, Massage or Holistic Massage, psychotherapy, wellness coaching, mandala breathwork, and much more. You can trust that trained and skilled therapists perform all our services to support the ultimate relaxation experience.

We are free from

  • Mineral oils
  • Parabens
  • Sulfates
  • Artificial fragrances or colors
  • Animal products
  • Animal testing
